text_block_list.text: Whassat? What'chu talkin' about?! Golshi's full go, anytime, all the time!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But you gotta meet me halfway, catch
my drift?
None of that boring,
half-baked training, yo!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Don't even think about subjecting me to
a snooze
fest today.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
If you try it, we'll go white-water rafting
instead,
and you're gonna be the raft!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I value my life too much, so I curate
today's
training schedule entirely around
Голд Шип's
demands.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
